description: Get the SpiderPR wire-distribution result for a job — provider order id, distribution status (queued|submitted|published|failed), published URL, and wire report URL. Convenience wrapper for get_job_results.

job_id.description: SpiderPR job ID to get results for.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: pr_get_result
